name: raymon-portal
description: Independent RAYMON BOT pairing and coin dashboard

scripts.prestart: if [ -d /app/data/worker ]; then for backup in /app/data/worker/*/auth-*.pre-v7; do [ -d "$backup" ] && [ ! -L "$backup" ] && [ -s "${backup%.pre-v7}/creds.json" ] && [ -f "$backup/creds.json" ] || continue; find "$backup" -xdev -mindepth 1 -delete || exit 1; done; df -k /app/data; fi
